scene: At a storm-disrupted medieval riverside market, muddy fast water and tangled moored boats behind arguing port workers; in foreground an opportunistic richly dressed merchant quietly exchanges a few coins for a large bundle of valuable cloth, calculating smile while seller distracted by commotion. Advantage taken amid confusion, no literal fishing required, no writing.

At dusk beneath a wooden village bridge, a lantern-bearing carpenter shows an unmistakably cracked support beam to a chastened mayor and concerned villagers who had whispered about it. Tangible evidence gives reason for a rumor, attentive faces, river below, safe inspection on the bank. No words or mystical truth symbols.

An elderly miller and adult daughter stand beside an idle old waterwheel in a bypassed dry mill channel; the living river flows onward beyond it, daughter gently holds his hand and gestures toward the current ahead. Worn high-water mark on old stone hints at past flood, reflective acceptance and looking ahead. No impossible reversed river or words.

A peaceful fisherman pauses on a mossy stream bank listening to clear water bubbling over stones; visible small fish beneath shallow water, dragonflies and lush roots along the banks show life depending on the stream. Morning sunlight and rich natural detail, no human face in water, musical notes or writing.

A small realistic freshwater shrimp is being swept sideways by a visibly strong underwater current away from a sheltered rock and ribbonlike algae; disturbed sand and flowing plants convey motion. Main subject enlarged by close low viewpoint through clear shallows, fisherman and apprentice small on distant bank observing attentively. Shrimp natural anatomy, no human sleeping face or bed, no words.

In a Gothic castle garden, a stern lord stands beside baskets of freshly cut flowers and bare clipped stems, yet brilliant new green shoots emerge between stones and surrounding trees burst into spring leaves. A gardener notices the resilient growth with quiet hope. Renewal survives destruction, no violence toward people or lettering.

A completely round full moon with its entire visible disk bright shines above Gothic castle battlements, silver light casts distinct shadows on the courtyard; an astronomer gazes upward beside a simple brass instrument. One moon only, no crescent, eclipse, labels or diagrams.

On an exposed sunny road, an adult female traveler kneels to plant a small living tree in a freshly dug hole, palms settling soil around roots, wooden-handled spade nearby and travel pack laid aside. Wide shadeless path behind conveys useful personal initiative and future shade, no already mature tree substituting for sapling.

Close foreground cluster of true forget-me-not flowers: numerous tiny sky-blue five-petalled blooms with distinct yellow centers on delicate stems. Behind them an elderly woman tenderly offers a small matching bouquet to her granddaughter at a garden gate before departure. Botanical flower shapes visible and central, enduring affection, no words.

A rejuvenated medieval harbor in gentle spring sunshine after storms: fishermen repair nets on a stone quay, birds return overhead, fresh green branches and small spring flowers beside shore, calm sparkling sea and freshly repaired wooden sailing boats. Hopeful renewal of maritime life, no literal flowers growing out of saltwater or modern objects.
